name: Trump Hotel, Doonbeg Ireland
insider_take: This clifftop castle sits on one of Ireland's most dramatic stretches of Atlantic coastline, where championship golf meets ancient Celtic heritage.
whats_special: The hotel occupies a stunning position along the Wild Atlantic Way, featuring an 18-hole links golf course designed by Greg Norman that winds through towering sand dunes. The property sits near the historic village of Doonbeg, where traditional Irish music sessions happen nightly in centuries-old pubs. The rugged coastline here is famous for its massive Atlantic swells, making it a premier surfing destination.
pro_tip: Book a tee time during sunset hours - the 14th hole offers breathtaking views over Doughmore Bay, and you might spot seals playing in the surf below the cliffs.
dont_miss: The nearby Cliffs of Moher (30 minutes away) are Ireland's most visited natural attraction, and Loop Head Peninsula offers some of the country's best whale watching. In Doonbeg village, visit Morrissey's pub for authentic Irish hospitality and catch traditional céilí dancing on weekend nights.
pros: Championship golf course with dramatic Atlantic Ocean views
Stunning clifftop location on Ireland's Wild Atlantic Way
Exceptional fine dining with local Irish ingredients
cons: Remote location requires significant travel time
